newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Feb 24.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Feb 24.

text.p: Crude shipping port Pajaritos in Veracruz state, and its parent port Coatzacoalcos, were reported shut Monday, Communications and Transport Ministry said in its 1000 local/1600 GMT daily meteorological report.

The ports were shut on Saturday at 1515 local/2115 GMT and winds were reported at between 35 and 50 km per hour with waves up to 9 feet high. Dos Bocas in Tabasco state was reported open at 0800 local after also being shut Saturday.
Alvarado was closed to smaller tourism and fishing boats, the ministry said.
The report advised against sailing in the Gulf of Tehuantepec and the southern Gulf of Mexico because of waves and high winds.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.

Isolated rains and lower temperatures along the Baja California peninsula and Sonora state with winds between 20 and 30 km per hour, except in the Gulf of Tehuantepec where winds at 20 to 25 knots (38 to 47 km/22 to 28 miles per hour) and expected to diminish later in the day.
A weak cold front in the northern region dissipating and some light rains along most of the coast, with winds from the east and southeast mostly at 20 to 30 km per hour.
Scarce clouds and eastern winds, with mostly sunny skies. Winds at about 20 to 30 km per hour.
